description: This Java source file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing Note entities related to various portfolio components such as loans, clients, groups, savings accounts, and transactions within the Fineract application.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: A JPA repository interface for managing Note entities, enabling CRUD and custom query methods for retrieving notes associated with various entities like loans, clients, groups, transactions, and savings accounts.

methods.name: findByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with a specific client.

methods.name: findByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with a specific group.

methods.name: findByLoanAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by loan and note ID.

methods.name: findByClientAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by client and note ID.

methods.name: findByGroupAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by group and note ID.

methods.name: findByLoanTransactionAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note associated with a particular loan transaction and ID.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves notes linked to a savings account.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccountAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note associated with a savings account and note ID.

methods.name: findBySavingsTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes linked via a savings transaction ID.

methods.name: deleteAllBySavingsAccount
methods.description: Deletes all notes associated with a specified savings account.
